newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to delay output, export order announcement.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to delay output, export order announcement.

text.p: Taiwan's economics ministry said on Wednesday it was postponing Thursday's scheduled announcement of January's industrial output and export orders indices to February 25.

"Because of a five-day Chinese New Year holiday this month (February 6-10), we will delay the announcement of January export orders and industrial output indices to 10:30 a.m. (0230 GMT) on February 25," a ministry spokesman said by telephone.
Industrial output rose 6.11 percent year-on-year in December while export orders rose 0.96 percent year-on-year in December.

A Reuters poll on February 14 of five economists produced an average forecast for a rise of 5.02 percent in annual industrial output growth in January and an average forecast for a rise of 1.58 percent for annual export orders growth in January.
